property_summary: withdrawGovernanceAsset must pay back exactly the amount recorded in the caller's pending flash decision (equal to the token inflow at deposit time), regardless of any later change to the global flashGovernanceConfig.amount; the mutant instead sends the current global config amount, so the token's outflow diverges from its inflow whenever the config amount is reconfigured between deposit and withdrawal.
change_summary: Transfer the global flashGovernanceConfig.amount instead of the caller's pending decision amount, so the withdrawn amount can differ from the deposited amount.
